key_equations_and_data: Temperature encoding (§13.3, §3.2 precision trap, skill isaac-sim-spg 'Temperature encoding'): c = (T − T_ref)/T_span with T_ref = 200 K, T_span = 800 K, so c ∈ [0,1] for 200–1000 K; decode T = c·T_span + T_ref. Must be a float32 AOV; fallback if float32 unavailable: coarse/fine split across two fp16 channels (R coarse, G fine). Acceptance: rendered-ramp round trip < 10 mK (§13.3, §15 Tier 1 table). Constants T_REF_K, T_SPAN_K must live in irsim (CLAUDE.md: constants in irsim.radiometry.constants or a dedicated encoding module).

Precision facts the tests must reproduce (§3.2 line 170, §13.3 line 978): fp16 spacing at 300 K = 2^8·2^-10 = 0.25 K (5× a 50 mK NETD); 8-bit unorm over 200–400 K = 0.78 K/code. float32 spacing at c≈0.125 is ~1.2e-5 K — comfortably < 10 mK.

AOV set and formats (§13.3 table, skill 'AOV set'): PtSelfIllumination (or custom) → encoded T, float32; DiffuseAlbedo or material-ID → emissivity lookup key, uint8/float; Normal → surface normal (world or view), fp16 ok; DistanceToCamera → path length d, float32 (ray length, not image-plane depth); AmbientOcclusion (or custom) → sky-view factor V_s, fp16 ok; MotionVectors → image-plane velocity, fp16 ok; SemanticSegmentation → labels, uint. Alternative T carrier: HdrColor with max bounces = 0 (§13.1 step 2).

G-buffer contract consumed by all six stages (§13.4 diagram; conftest.py keys): temperature_k (or encoded c) float32, normal_dot_view float32 (= |n·v| = cos θ, §13.5 line 1064), distance_m float32, material_id int32 (transported as float in SPG, §13.5 line 1062), sky_view_factor float32 ∈ [0,1], plus optional motion_px_per_frame float32x2 and semantic_id uint32.

Stage 1 band_radiance (§13.4, §13.5, §5.3a, §4.2 Level B): T = c·T_span + T_ref; u = (T − lutT0)/(lutT1 − lutT0)·(N−1) clamped to [0, N−1.001]; B = LUT[i0]·(1−fr) + LUT[i0+1]·fr; ε(θ) = ε0·[1 − a·(1−cosθ)^p] (sketch hard-codes p = 4); L_env = V_s·L_sky + (1−V_s)·L_ground; L = ε·B + (1−ε)·L_env [W m⁻² sr⁻¹]. Per-material table matEps = (eps0, a) float2 per band (§13.5 line 1046). Kirchhoff identity usable as test: T_s = T_sky = T_ground ⇒ L = B(T) for every ε (§4.1).

Band LUT the kernel loads once (§3.2b, §13.2 cuda.static, §13.5 line 1111): L_B(T) tabulated on T ∈ [200,1000] K at 0.05 K (N = 16001), float32, one table per band per quantity (Lb, Lb_q, dLb_dT); generated offline and loaded as a binary asset — format unspecified by spec (scripts/generate_luts.py plans .npy, which Lua/Unreal cannot read); Unreal needs PF_R32_FLOAT texture (§14 line 1149, 1159).

Sky radiance scalar inputs to stage 1 (§5.3a): T_sky(θ_el) = T_air − ΔT_clear·(1−cloud)·cos^q(θ_el), ΔT_clear ≈ 55–70 K LWIR clear/dry, 5–10 K overcast, q ≈ 0.5–1.0; L_sky = Lb(T_sky), L_ground = Lb(T_ground). Both come from the ONE WeatherSeries (CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 6).

Stage 2 atmosphere (§7.1, §13.4): τ = exp(−γ_B·d) with γ from the (band, atmosphere, humidity, visibility) table (§7.2), γ_LWIR ≈ γ0 + β·w with Magnus w (§7.3); L' = τ·L + (1−τ)·B(T_air). Identity for tests: T = T_air ⇒ L' = L for any d; d = 0 ⇒ L' = L.

Stage 3 optics (§8.1, §8.2, §8.3, §13.4): E_FPA = π·L'·τ_opt/(4F²+1)·cos⁴θ_ij, Φ = E·A_d; Φ_self ≈ A_d·Ω_eff·(1−τ_opt)·Lb(T_housing), Ω_eff = π/(4F²+1); the aperture factor is defined ONCE in irsim.optics (non-negotiable 5); field angle θ_ij from focal_length_mm and pitch_um; box-filter downsample from a 3–4× supersampled render (§8.3 line 580, §13.4 line 1030) giving MTF_det = |sinc(π w ξ)| (0.64 at Nyquist for the 12 µm/F1.0/10 µm worked case) plus aliasing.

Stage 4 detector (§9.1, §9.2, §13.4): bolometer per-pixel IIR across frames S_n = S_{n−1} + (S_ideal_n − S_{n−1})·(1 − e^{−Δt/τ_th}), Δt = 1/frame_rate_hz, τ_th = thermal_time_constant_ms — requires a persistent per-pixel state buffer across frames; photon path N_e = η A_d t_int π τ_opt/(4F²+1) ∫R L_q dλ + i_dark t_int/q, DN = min(DN_max, floor((N_e+n_e)/N_well·2^N_bits)).

Stage 5 noise (§10.2, §10.3, §10.4, §13.4): σ²_total = σ²_T + σ²_V + σ²_H + σ²_TV + σ²_TH + σ²_VH + σ²_TVH with synthesis per component (i.i.d. per pixel per frame; fixed 2-D field drifting with fpn_drift_tau_s; per-row / per-column fixed; per-row / per-column per frame; global per frame); magnitudes anchored so NETD at 300 K = netd_mk_at_300k (§9.4); bad pixels 0.15 % Poisson-clustered; NUC residual (§11.2); added in radiance/electron space (§3.4 rule, non-negotiable 3); temporal seed from rtx.frameId (§13.2, §13.4 line 1019) so frames are reproducible.

Stage 6 ISP (§11.1, §11.3, §11.4, §13.4): order raw DN → bad-pixel replace → NUC → temporal filter → [T_app branch] → AGC → gamma → polarity → palette → 8-bit; linear AGC y = clip((x − x_plo)/(x_phi − x_plo), 0, 1)^{1/γ} with p = 0.5 % / 99.5 %; plateau equalisation with per-bin clip P (config plateau: 0.012) — a global histogram reduction, not element-wise; DDE = unsharp mask with dde_gain; palette gray|ironbow|rainbow|lava; polarity white_hot|black_hot.

Pipeline outputs (§13.4 line 1027, §12.2 outputs, skill line 142): IrRadiance float32 W m⁻² sr⁻¹; IrApparentT float32 K = Lb⁻¹(L_measured) (§3.3 — must NOT be the kinetic T); IrDN16 uint16; IrDisplay8 RGBA8.
